open_points.subject: timestamp-bearing models
open_points.text: “A record carries the instant it was created and the instant it was last changed” conflicts with later model-specific facts that omit a last-changed instant, and with “A room and a pointer have no last-changed instant.”
open_points.question: Which models must carry created and last-changed instants, and do the model-specific fact lists override the general statement?
options: Only Project and Customer carry both instants; other models carry only the instants explicitly listed for them
Every entity carries both, with last-changed equal to created for immutable entities
Every durable record carries both, except Room and ArtifactPointer
open_points.default_guess: Treat each model’s explicit fact list as authoritative; only Project and Customer carry both created and last-changed instants.

open_points.subject: Room authorship
open_points.text: M03 says “Who added it — the owner or the agent through Kernel — is not a fact of the room,” while M07 defines ActingPrincipal as recorded “on a room and on a pointer” and says it is “Embedded in audit entries, rooms and pointers.”
open_points.question: Does a Room carry the ActingPrincipal that added it?
options: No; room authorship is not stored
Yes; every room stores its adding principal
Only agent-created rooms store the session principal
open_points.default_guess: Do not store room authorship, following M03’s explicit decision.

open_points.subject: imported pointer provenance
open_points.text: Every pointer is said to carry the principal that published it and, when applicable, the instant and principal of withdrawal, but imported pointers keep legacy identities and states while “Revisions and times” mentions only their source published and superseded instants.
open_points.question: What publication and withdrawal principals and withdrawal instant does an imported legacy pointer carry when the source did not record them?
options: Allow explicit unavailable legacy provenance while retaining the source facts that exist
Attribute publication and withdrawal to the owner performing the import
Attribute them to the pointer type’s owner service and use the import instant when a transition instant is absent
Refuse any imported pointer lacking all required provenance facts
open_points.default_guess: Allow unavailable legacy provenance and preserve only source facts that actually exist.

open_points.subject: whole-project deletion
open_points.text: M05 says pointers are “Durable, owned by its Project record; kept after anonymisation,” but does not say what happens to them when an archived project is “deleted whole”; M02 and M03 explicitly say they go with project deletion.
open_points.question: When a Project is deleted whole, are its ArtifactPointer records also deleted?
options: Delete all of the project’s pointers with it
Keep the pointers internally but make them unreachable because the project is gone
Keep independent pointer records readable by pointer id
open_points.default_guess: Delete all pointers owned by the deleted project.

open_points.subject: AuditEntry identity
open_points.text: AuditEntry is classified as an entity and “two entries with equal facts are two events,” but its complete facts contain no audit-entry identity and the identity-format section says nothing about one.
open_points.question: What makes two otherwise equal AuditEntry entities distinct, and does Registry mint an audit-entry identifier?
options: Registry mints an opaque UUID for each entry
An append-only sequence number is the entry’s identity
The occurrence or storage position is internal identity and no identity fact is stored
AuditEntry should be a value rather than an entity
open_points.default_guess: Mint an opaque UUID for every AuditEntry.

open_points.subject: declined access request audit
open_points.text: R0-58 says Registry records “only significant changes of state” and names “granting and revoking an agent session’s projects,” while M09 adds “answering a request” to the actions that write an entry; declining a request clears it but grants or revokes no project.
open_points.question: Does declining an access request create an AuditEntry?
options: No; only a grant resulting from an accepted request is logged as a grant
Yes; every grant or decline answer is logged
Yes, but only when clearing the request changes the access version
open_points.default_guess: Do not log a decline; log an accepted request through the resulting project grant.

open_points.subject: audit subjects for non-project actions
open_points.text: The subject is defined as a project or customer, with a special case for a session grant and another for import, but no subject is defined for erasing old audit entries or for a declined request if request answers are logged.
open_points.question: What subject fact does an AuditEntry carry when the action changes no Project or Customer?
options: The subject is optional for such actions
Use a typed system subject such as the audit log or Registry instance
For audit erasure use no subject, and for request answers use the agent session
Do not create entries for actions that lack a project or customer subject
open_points.default_guess: Use a typed subject: the session for request answers and the Registry audit log for audit-entry erasure.

open_points.subject: accepted no-op actions
open_points.text: Audit entries are records of “significant changes of state” and of Registry’s “accepted changes,” but the action vocabulary includes archiving, anonymising and customer erasure, whose repeated invocations can return the existing record unchanged.
open_points.question: Does an accepted action that makes no state change—such as archiving an already archived project, anonymising an already anonymised project, or erasing an already erased customer—create an AuditEntry and confirmation id?
options: No; only the first invocation that changes state creates an entry
Yes; every accepted invocation creates an entry and, where confirmed, a confirmation id
Mint a confirmation id for every confirmed invocation but write an entry only when state changes
open_points.default_guess: Create neither a change entry nor a retained confirmation id when the action changes no state.

open_points.subject: artifact pointers in the agent projection
open_points.text: The agent projection is stated to contain “pointers” or “artifact pointers” without saying whether that means the full history, only currently published pointers, or only the latest published pointer of each type.
open_points.question: Which ArtifactPointer records does reading the agent projection return?
options: Every published, superseded and withdrawn pointer in the project
Only pointers whose status is published
Only the latest published pointer of each declared type
Pointer summaries selected by a later request parameter
open_points.default_guess: Return every pointer in the project, matching the separately defined artifact-history read.
